steps: Prepare a set of powder samples covering the expected API concentration range of the new blend.
Acquire reference API concentrations by an independent assay (e.g., HPLC).
Record NIR spectra with the existing probe under normal process conditions.
Record Raman spectra simultaneously (or sequentially) with a fiber‑optic Raman probe at the same location.
Build three chemometric models: NIR‑only, Raman‑only, and fused NIR‑Raman (low‑level data fusion).
Validate each model on held‑out samples to assess prediction error and robustness.
Then measure in-line or in a pilot set-up against the reference method.
feasibility.decisionBasis: If the NIR‑only model meets the agreed accuracy, the Raman addition is unnecessary; if performance degrades, the fused model will be evaluated for improvement. Agree two things separately with the customer before the test: the model accuracy required against the reference method, and the alarm or action threshold applied to the measured value.
